import sys

def solve():
    data = list(map(int, sys.stdin.read().split()))
    if not data:
        return
    it = iter(data)
    n = next(it)
    K = next(it)
    ts = []
    all_sum = 0
    for _ in range(K):
        a = next(it)
        b = next(it)
        ts.append([a, b])
        all_sum += b - a

    INF = 99999999
    dpe = [INF] * (n + 1)
    dpo = [INF] * (n + 1)

    if ts[0][0] > n:
        print("Hungry")
        return

    dpe[ts[0][0]] = 0

    for i in range(K):
        ndpo = [INF] * (n + 1)
        ndpe = [INF] * (n + 1)
        w = ts[i][1] - ts[i][0]

        # deque for dpe
        dq = [0] * (n + 2)
        head = 0
        tail = 0
        for j in range(n + 1):
            while tail > head and dpe[dq[tail - 1]] >= dpe[j]:
                tail -= 1
            while tail > head and dq[head] < j - w:
                head += 1
            dq[tail] = j
            tail += 1
            ndpo[j] = min(ndpo[j], dpe[dq[head]] + 1)
            if j + w <= n:
                ndpe[j + w] = min(ndpe[j + w], dpe[j])

        # deque for dpo
        head = 0
        tail = 0
        for j in range(n + 1):
            while tail > head and dpo[dq[tail - 1]] >= dpo[j]:
                tail -= 1
            while tail > head and dq[head] < j - w:
                head += 1
            dq[tail] = j
            tail += 1
            ndpe[j] = min(ndpe[j], dpo[dq[head]] + 1)
            ndpo[j] = min(ndpo[j], dpo[j])

        dpo = ndpo
        dpe = ndpe

        for j in range(n + 1):
            dpe[j] = min(dpe[j], dpo[j] + 1)
            dpo[j] = min(dpo[j], dpe[j] + 1)

        if i == K - 1:
            s = 2 * n - ts[i][1]
        else:
            s = ts[i + 1][0] - ts[i][1]

        # shift dpe
        for j in range(n, s - 1, -1):
            dpe[j] = dpe[j - s]
        for j in range(min(n, s - 1), -1, -1):
            dpe[j] = INF

    ans = min(dpe[n], dpo[n])
    if ans >= 9999999:
        print("Hungry")
    else:
        print("Full")
        print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    solve()
